scope: macOS Cocoa/Metal reference host: Retina physical viewport, CAMetalLayer drawable presentation and readback, AccessKit Cocoa tree with physical-pixel bounds, AXPress and real WindowServer CGEvent activation, ordered Latin+CJK font stack, graceful retirement and an ad-hoc signed .app bundle

environment.metric_source: sw_vers, xcodebuild -version, host stage logs and drawable readback

checks.name: metal_surface_present
checks.detail: winit creates the Cocoa window and CAMetalLayer surface; wgpu selects the Apple M2 Metal adapter; Queue::present is confirmed by gpu_presented on every frame.

checks.name: retina_viewport
checks.detail: 960x640 logical points map to a 1920x1280 physical drawable; the engine receives the physical extent and scale 2 and lays the root scene out in logical points.

checks.name: drawable_readback
checks.detail: Each presented drawable is copied to a staging buffer and written as a PPM; the declared linear colors are counted after sRGB encoding (18,20,26 -> 75,79,90; 40,130,90 -> 110,189,160; 190,92,52 -> 247,166,128). Two independent runs produced identical counts and digests.

checks.name: accesskit_cocoa_tree
checks.detail: The real AX API exposes AXButton title "激活 Activate" at screen frame 421,424 627x120, matching the engine node bounds after the host scales logical bounds into physical pixels for AccessKit.

checks.name: accesskit_press_activation
checks.detail: AXUIElementPerformAction(AXPress) returns success, reaches the app as AccessKit ActionRequested(Click), activates the scene button and repaints.

checks.name: windowserver_pointer_click
checks.detail: A CGEvent left click posted at the button centre 734,484 is delivered by NSApplication to winit, routes through DesktopInput and Engine::pointer, and produces a second versioned activation and repaint.

checks.name: chinese_font_stack
checks.detail: The host injects the same ordered stack as Android/Windows (DejaVuSans then DroidSansFallbackFull). The Chinese title line and the 激活 Activate button render with real glyphs (23,565 text pixels); --cjk-tofu drops the fallback face and the same area becomes missing-glyph boxes (15,349 text pixels) with a different frame digest.

checks.name: bundle_executable
checks.detail: The release binary inside the signed .app runs directly and presents the identical first frame (sha256 e3f1451c...) to the debug verification build.

checks.name: graceful_retirement
checks.detail: retired=true; the host deactivates and retires the native view before exiting the event loop and the process exits 0.

checks.name: launchservices_open
checks.reason: `open` cannot launch apps in this sandboxed session: `open -W` reports GetProcessPID() failure for the Jasper bundle, and the same failure hangs for a control bundle wrapping /usr/bin/true. The bundle is therefore verified by structure, signature and direct execution, not by LaunchServices.

cross_platform_boundary.engine: The default engine core stays macOS-independent; the host consumes jasper-ui-engine public modules only.
cross_platform_boundary.host: macos/ is a binary crate that owns the Cocoa window, CAMetalLayer surface, Metal device/queue, AccessKit Cocoa adapter and .app packaging.
cross_platform_boundary.coordinates: The engine viewport and pointer routing use logical points; the drawable and AccessKit bounds use physical pixels, and the host converts between them.
cross_platform_boundary.input: winit mouse/keyboard/IME events -> DesktopInput -> Engine; the verification adds a live AXPress and a WindowServer CGEvent click.

limits: No Metal device-loss handling (the engine reports device-loss recovery as Unsupported).
No measured vsync deadline, compositor frame pacing or hardware-independent timing claim.
No live system IME composition round trip; IME events are forwarded when macOS delivers them.
No notarization, hardened runtime or App Store distribution; the bundle is ad-hoc signed.
No Intel (x86_64) runtime acceptance; --universal is compile-time only.
LaunchServices launch could not be verified in this sandboxed session.
